description: Foundation: create the M3 engine venv, pin + install the new M3 runtime dependencies on top of the M2 stack, add their docs/LICENSES.md rows in the same change, register pytest markers, and wire pipeline.yaml stages + typed IngestConfig + settings. This is the prerequisite every later feature depends on (venv + config home). No recognition logic yet. Depends on nothing; all later features depend on it.
steps: Create the engine venv in the worktree: from engine/ run `py -3.11 -m venv .venv` (use the Python 3.11 launcher on this host; if `py` is unavailable use `$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Python/Python311/python.exe -m venv .venv`). It is gitignored; do NOT commit it.

Edit engine/requirements.txt: add pinned M3 runtime deps, verifying each exact version against official PyPI metadata first (use nearest existing patch in the same minor if a listed patch is gone, and record the actual installed version in docs/m3-verification.md later): pypdfium2==5.14.0, pillow-heif==0.18.0, onnxruntime==1.19.* (pin the exact latest 1.19 patch confirmed on PyPI), pytesseract==0.3.13, and the PP-OCR ONNX post-process transitives shapely + pyclipper ONLY if the chosen ONNX text decode path needs them (otherwise omit and note it). opencv-python-headless and numpy are already pinned in M2 -- reuse, do NOT re-add.

Install into the venv: from engine/ run `.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu` (requirements-dev.txt already includes -r requirements.txt). Then `.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip check`.

Add a docs/LICENSES.md row for EACH new runtime dep under the 'Engine (Python 3.11) -- runtime' table: pypdfium2 (BSD-3-Clause/Apache-2.0), pillow-heif (BSD-3-Clause; note bundled libheif LGPL-3.0 dynamically linked), onnxruntime (MIT), pytesseract (Apache-2.0) + a note that system/bundled Tesseract 5.x is Apache-2.0, and shapely/pyclipper (BSD/MIT) if added.

Add the 'Deferred / opt-in only' docs/LICENSES.md row: DocLayout-YOLO / doclayout-yolo 0.0.4 / ultralytics -- AGPL-3.0 -- opt-in only, never default, not bundled (re-confirm the classifier from the official source at adoption; design verified 2026-10-18). Also confirm the existing PyMuPDF row stays (M3 adds no PyMuPDF dep).

Register pytest markers `model` and `latex` in the engine's pytest config (engine/pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] markers, or engine/pytest.ini -- match whatever the repo already uses; if neither exists, add engine/pytest.ini with a markers entry) so @pytest.mark.model / @pytest.mark.latex raise no unknown-marker warning.

Edit engine/texora_engine/pipeline_config.py: make Stages.ingest and Stages.layout live ids (already typed str|None -- just document/use), ensure RecognizeStage.text is used, set stages.export. Add a typed IngestConfig Pydantic model (base_dpi:int=260, max_dpi:int=400, small_font_px:int=12, born_digital_char_threshold:int, born_digital_coverage:float=0.05) with a nested PreprocessSettings (deskew:bool=True, denoise:bool=True, binarize:bool=False, perspective:bool=False, auto_crop:bool=True); add an `ingest: IngestConfig` field to PipelineConfig. pipeline.yaml is the source of truth for ingest values, mirrored into settings (design N5).

Edit pipeline.yaml to the design S9 default block: stages.ingest: pypdfium2; stages.layout: pp_doclayout_onnx; stages.recognize.text: pp_ocrv5_onnx (keep formula: pix2tex); stages.export: markdown; and the top-level ingest: block with base_dpi/max_dpi/small_font_px/preprocess toggles. Keep the permissive-first comment. Do NOT write any AGPL engine id (doclayout_yolo) as a default.

Edit engine/texora_engine/settings.py: add TEXORA_ENGINE_-backed fields with defaults (no magic constants): a page/region block (region_timeout_s:float=30.0, region_concurrency:int=1), recognize block (text_fallback_to_tesseract:bool=True, tesseract_cmd:str|None=None, tesseract_data_dir:str|None=None), export block (preamble:str='article', figure_asset_dir). Reuse the existing settings.device for the onnxruntime execution-provider selection.

Extend engine/tests/test_pipeline_config.py (assert ingest/layout/text/export ids load from the real pipeline.yaml; IngestConfig defaults + preprocess toggles parse) and engine/tests/test_settings.py (new settings fields present with correct defaults).
acceptance_criteria: `engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip check` prints `No broken requirements found.`
`engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import pypdfium2, PIL, pillow_heif, onnxruntime, pytesseract, cv2, numpy; print('ok')"` prints `ok`.
docs/LICENSES.md has a runtime row for each new dep and the AGPL DocLayout-YOLO opt-in row in the Deferred section.

load_pipeline_config() parses the new pipeline.yaml with stages.ingest='pypdfium2', stages.layout='pp_doclayout_onnx', stages.recognize.text='pp_ocrv5_onnx', stages.export='markdown', and a typed ingest block.
Running the full engine gate (ruff/black/mypy/pytest) passes with the M2 suite unchanged plus the new config/settings tests.
verification: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import pypdfium2, PIL, pillow_heif, onnxruntime, pytesseract, cv2, numpy; print('ok')"

cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check . && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m black --check . --line-length 100 && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m mypy texora_engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q
findings: Engine venv created at engine/.venv (Python 3.11.9, gitignored). Installed+verified M3 runtime pins (all confirmed on PyPI before pinning): pypdfium2==5.14.0 (BSD-3-Clause/Apache-2.0), pillow-heif==0.18.0 (BSD-3-Clause; bundled libheif LGPL-3.0 dynamically linked), onnxruntime==1.19.2 (MIT; latest 1.19 patch, cp311 win_amd64 wheel present), pytesseract==0.3.13 (Apache-2.0). opencv-python-headless==4.10.0.84 and numpy==1.26.4 reused from M2 (NOT re-added). torch 2.3.1+cpu / torchvision 0.18.1+cpu carried from M2 via the PyTorch CPU index. pip check = 'No broken requirements found.'; import smoke prints 'ok'. shapely+pyclipper DELIBERATELY OMITTED (FEAT-001 adds no ONNX text-decode code) -- the text-adapter feature (PP-OCRv5 ONNX) must pin shapely+pyclipper (BSD/MIT) IF its postprocess decode needs them, adding the LICENSES.md rows in that same change. pytest markers 'model' and 'latex' registered in engine/pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options]. pipeline.yaml now sets stages.ingest=pypdfium2, stages.layout=pp_doclayout_onnx, stages.recognize.text=pp_ocrv5_onnx (formula stays pix2tex), stages.export=markdown, ensemble=null, plus a top-level ingest: block; no AGPL id (doclayout_yolo) is written anywhere as a default. pipeline_config.py gained typed PreprocessSettings + IngestConfig (base_dpi=260, max_dpi=400, small_font_px=12, born_digital_char_threshold=20 [design gave no explicit default -> chose a documented ge=0 default of 20], born_digital_coverage=0.05) and PipelineConfig.ingest. settings.py gained TEXORA_ENGINE_-backed fields: region_timeout_s=30.0, region_concurrency=1, text_fallback_to_tesseract=True, tesseract_cmd=None, tesseract_data_dir=None, export_preamble='article' (field name differs from design's 'export.preamble' label -- flat pydantic-settings field, env TEXORA_ENGINE_EXPORT_PREAMBLE), figure_asset_dir=Path('assets'); device reused for onnxruntime EP selection. mypy override for new untyped libs (pypdfium2/pillow_heif/onnxruntime/pytesseract/cv2) NOT yet added -- add per-feature when a module first imports them (FEAT-001 imports none, so mypy is clean as-is on 32 files). Full gate GREEN: ruff clean, black clean (50 files), mypy clean (32 files), pytest all pass (3 pre-existing M2 model-gated skips unchanged). Verification recorded in docs/m3-verification.md.
